title: Foams with 3D Spatially Programmed Mechanics Enabled by Autonomous Active Learning on Viscous Thread Printing.
summary: Gaussian-process regression and active learning guided viscous-thread printing of foams with programmed stiffness, and the fabricated foams' measured modulus was compared with predictions. The result is the manufactured foams, not the printing platform alone.
organization: Northeastern University; Boston University; University of Washington

evidence.tested: Saved primary abstract and ledger-recorded publisher passages support fabricated foams with programmed stiffness and measured-versus-predicted modulus; admit manufacturing results, not the platform alone.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Gaussian-process regression and active learning is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
